svg.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Hydrogen sites of CaH6 on the ELF of its calcium lattice
svg.desc: Three VESTA views of one cubic cell. The first shows CaH6 with hydrogen cages around the calcium atoms. The other two show the ELF of the calcium lattice with no hydrogen in the calculation, from ELFNet and from DFT, with the hydrogen sites of CaH6 drawn on top. The ELF forms a network between the calcium atoms and the hydrogen sites sit on it.
